description: This file defines the 'Profile' class in the Twig template engine, specifically used for profiling template rendering durations, memory usage, and nested profile data within the Twig Profiler component.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: A class representing a profiling record for a Twig template, block, macro, or the root template, capable of tracking durations, memory usage, and nested profiles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Profile instance with optional template, type, and name, and starts profiling.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the name of the template associated with this profile.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of profile (e.g., ROOT, template, block, macro).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the profile.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type ROOT.

methods.name: isTemplate
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type TEMPLATE.

methods.name: isBlock
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type BLOCK.

methods.name: isMacro
methods.description: Checks if the profile is of type MACRO.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Returns an array of nested Profile instances.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Adds a nested Profile to this profile's list of profiles.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns total duration in microseconds, summing child profiles if this is a root profile.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time in microseconds.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time in microseconds.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns memory usage difference in bytes between start and end.

methods.name: getPeakMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns peak memory usage difference in bytes between start and end.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Starts profiling by recording start time and memory usage.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Stops profiling by recording end time and memory usage.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets profiling data and restarts profiling.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over nested profiles.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the profile object for storage.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes stored data into the profile object.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Prepares the profile data for serialization.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Restores the profile data from serialized form.
